title: Apache Struts2 S2-053 Freemarker OGNL Injection
description: A Struts2 2.5.10 application, vulnerable to S2-053 (CVE-2017-12611): a Freemarker template uses an unsafe expression on a user-controlled value (redirectUri), so a submitted %{...} is evaluated as OGNL and runs commands.
question: Exploit S2-053 through the form's field to run commands on the server and read /ctf/flag.
